catalog.name: Stack
catalog.description: Lays out components in order, vertically by default or in a row. Use it for the root and to group related components. Requires children.

props.name: direction
props.description: "column" (default) stacks vertically.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children; "md" by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let a row wrap onto several lines.

props.name: children
props.description: Components to lay out, in order.

catalog.name: Grid
catalog.description: Places components in equal columns, for dashboards and side-by-side cards. Requires children; columns defaults to 2.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of equal columns, 1 to 6; 2 by default.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cells; "md" by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Components to place in grid cells, in order.

catalog.name: Card
catalog.description: A titled section that groups related content, such as one metric, one result, or one step. Requires a title and children.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card; it also names the card for screen readers.

props.name: description
props.description: One short supporting sentence under the title.

props.name: tone
props.description: Visual emphasis.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the card.

catalog.name: Heading
catalog.description: A heading that titles the content below it. Use it to structure a long response. Requires text; keep levels in order.

props.name: text
props.description: The heading text.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level 1 to 6; 2 by default. Do not skip levels.

catalog.name: Text
catalog.description: A paragraph of plain text. Use it for explanations around other components. Requires text.

props.name: text
props.description: Plain text. Markdown and HTML are shown literally. May be {"$expr": "..."} over bound names.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the text; "default" unless it matters.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size; "md" by default.

catalog.name: Image
catalog.description: An image from an http(s) or relative URL. Requires src and alt text that describes the image; add a caption when the image needs explaining.

props.name: src
props.description: http(s) or relative URL of the image. data: URLs are not rendered.

props.name: alt
props.description: Text alternative describing what the image shows. Required; never a filename.

props.name: caption
props.description: Visible caption under the image.

catalog.name: List
catalog.description: A bulleted or numbered list of short text items. Use it for steps, options, or highlights. Requires items.

props.name: items
props.description: One short text per item.

props.name: ordered
props.description: Number the items; bulleted by default.

catalog.name: Button
catalog.description: A button that sends a message back to the assistant when pressed, for choices and next steps ("Show details", "Book it"). Inside a Form it sends that form's values. Requires a label that says what it does.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text of the button; say what happens when it is pressed.

props.name: variant
props.description: "primary" for the main action; "danger" for destructive ones.

props.name: message
props.description: What the person is asking for, written as their message to the assistant. Defaults to the label.

props.name: action
props.type: { call?: string, args?: object, into?: string, set?: string, value?: any, send?: string }[]
props.description: Steps to run in order when pressed, instead of sending the message: call a tool, set a value, send a message. Stops at the first that fails.

catalog.name: Link
catalog.description: A link to a web page, email address, phone number, or section. Requires label text and an http(s), mailto:, tel:, relative, or #fragment href; other URLs are not linked.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible link text that makes sense out of context.

props.name: href
props.description: http(s), mailto:, tel:, relative, or #fragment URL. Other schemes are not linked.

catalog.name: Suggestions
catalog.description: Quick replies for likely next steps. Pressing one sends its text as the person's next message. Requires a label for the group and the list of replies; keep them short and few.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group of replies, such as 'Follow-up questions'. Required.

props.name: items
props.description: Short replies the person can send as their next message, each a sentence or less.

catalog.name: CopyButton
catalog.description: A button that copies text to the clipboard, such as a code snippet, command, or address. Show the text itself nearby, since the person cannot see what is copied. Requires a label that says what is copied and the value.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text saying what is copied, such as 'Copy install command'.

props.name: value
props.description: The exact text placed on the clipboard.

catalog.name: Form
catalog.description: Groups form controls and a submit button. When the person submits, the assistant receives their answers, described with the controls' labels. Requires name, title, and children; put controls (TextField, Select, ...) inside, and a Button inside only for secondary actions.

props.name: name
props.description: Short identifier for the form, unique in the response.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the form. Add a Heading to show it.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button; "Submit" by default.

props.name: action
props.type: { call?: string, args?: object, into?: string, set?: string, value?: any, send?: string }[]
props.description: Steps to run in order on submit instead of sending the answers to the assistant: a call step without args receives the form's values by control name. Stops at the first that fails.

props.name: children
props.description: The form controls and any explanatory components.

catalog.name: TextField
catalog.description: A single-line text input (name, email, phone, URL). A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label and name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the field. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial text, or a binding {"$bind": name} the field reads and writes.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must fill this in.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example input; never a substitute for the label.

props.name: inputType
props.description: Kind of text: "text" (default), "email", "tel", or "url".

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the field.

catalog.name: TextArea
catalog.description: A multi-line text input for longer answers. A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label and name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the field. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial text, or a binding {"$bind": name}.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must fill this in.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example input; never a substitute for the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the field.

catalog.name: NumberField
catalog.description: A numeric input with increase and decrease buttons, for quantities and amounts. A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label and name; add min and max when there are limits.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the field. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial number, or a binding {"$bind": name} the field reads and writes; empty when omitted.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest allowed number.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest allowed number.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount one step changes the number; 1 by default.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must fill this in.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the field.

catalog.name: Select
catalog.description: A drop-down for choosing one of many options (more than five). A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label, name, and options.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the field. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices: plain strings (shown and stored as written) or { value, label } when the stored value differs from the text.

props.name: value
props.description: Initially chosen option value, or a binding {"$bind": name} the field reads and writes.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must choose one.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the field.

catalog.name: RadioGroup
catalog.description: Choose exactly one of a few visible options (five or fewer). A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label, name, and options.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible question or label naming the group. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices: plain strings (shown and stored as written) or { value, label } when the stored value differs from the text.

props.name: value
props.description: Initially chosen option value, or a binding {"$bind": name} the group reads and writes.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must choose one.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the group.

catalog.name: CheckboxGroup
catalog.description: Choose any number of a few visible options. A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label, name, and options; the value is the list of checked option values.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the group. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices: plain strings (shown and stored as written) or { value, label } when the stored value differs from the text.

props.name: value
props.description: Option values that start checked, or a binding {"$bind": name}.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the group.

catalog.name: Checkbox
catalog.description: A single yes/no choice such as accepting terms. The label is the visible text next to the box. Requires label and name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the checkbox. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: checked
props.description: Starts checked, or a binding {"$bind": name} the checkbox reads and writes.

props.name: required
props.description: Must be checked to submit.

catalog.name: Switch
catalog.description: An on/off setting that applies right away, such as notifications. The label names the setting. Requires label and name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the switch, naming the setting. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: checked
props.description: Starts on, or a binding {"$bind": name} the switch reads and writes.

catalog.name: Slider
catalog.description: A number chosen along a range, when the exact value matters less than the rough amount. A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label and name; min is 0 and max is 100 unless given.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the setting. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value; 0 by default.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value; 100 by default.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial value, or a binding {"$bind": name} the slider reads and writes; min by default.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount one step changes the value; 1 by default.

catalog.name: DatePicker
catalog.description: A calendar date. The value is "YYYY-MM-DD". A form control. Always give it a visible label; it names the control for everyone. Requires label and name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label naming the date. Required.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifier of the field, unique in its form.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial date as "YYYY-MM-DD", or a binding {"$bind": name}.

props.name: required
props.description: The person must pick a date.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text shown under the field.

catalog.name: Tabs
catalog.description: Switches between parallel views of the same subject (for example per region or per plan). Requires tabs, each { label, children }; only one view is visible at a time.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The tabs, each { label, children } where children are the components shown when the tab is selected.

catalog.name: Accordion
catalog.description: A list of sections that expand one at a time (or several with multiple). Use it for FAQs and long, skimmable content. Requires items, each { title, children, open? }.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several sections open at once.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string, open?: boolean, children: Component[] }[]
props.description: The sections, each { title, open?, children }.

catalog.name: Disclosure
catalog.description: One show/hide section for optional details. Requires summary and children; use Accordion for several.

props.name: summary
props.description: Visible text that toggles the details.

props.name: open
props.description: Starts open.

props.name: children
props.description: Details revealed when opened.

catalog.name: Table
catalog.description: A table for comparing items across attributes. Requires caption, columns, and rows; the first column should name each row. Use it instead of a chart when exact values matter. Large tables are cut off (24 columns, 800 cells).

props.name: caption
props.description: What the table shows; it names the table for screen readers.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column headings, left to right.

props.name: rows
props.description: One array of cells per row, in column order. The first cell names the row.

catalog.name: BarChart
catalog.description: Horizontal bars comparing a number across categories, best for long labels or rankings. Requires title and data ({ label, value } objects); add a description with the takeaway. A data table is included for screen readers.

props.name: title
props.description: What the chart shows; it names the chart. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: The bars, each { label, value }.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence stating the main takeaway.

props.name: categoryLabel
props.description: Axis label for the categories; "Category".

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Axis label for the numbers; "Value".

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to numbers, such as "%" or " ms".

catalog.name: ColumnChart
catalog.description: Vertical columns comparing a number across a few short categories. Requires title and data ({ label, value } objects); add a description with the takeaway.

props.name: title
props.description: What the chart shows; it names the chart. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: The bars, each { label, value }.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence stating the main takeaway.

props.name: categoryLabel
props.description: Axis label for the categories; "Category".

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Axis label for the numbers; "Value".

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to numbers, such as "%" or " ms".

catalog.name: LineChart
catalog.description: A line showing how a number changes along an ordered axis such as time. Requires title and data ({ x, y } objects with increasing x); add a description with the takeaway.

props.name: title
props.description: What the chart shows; it names the chart. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: The points, each { x, y }.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence stating the main takeaway.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Axis label for x; "X".

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Axis label for y; "Y".

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to y numbers, such as "%" or " ms".

catalog.name: AreaChart
catalog.description: Like LineChart with the area below filled, for totals that accumulate. Requires title and data ({ x, y } objects with increasing x).

props.name: title
props.description: What the chart shows; it names the chart. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: The points, each { x, y }.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence stating the main takeaway.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Axis label for x; "X".

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Axis label for y; "Y".

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to y numbers, such as "%" or " ms".

catalog.name: PieChart
catalog.description: Parts of a whole, for up to six slices that sum to a meaningful total. Requires title and data ({ label, value } objects with values >= 0). Prefer BarChart for more slices.

props.name: title
props.description: What the chart shows; it names the chart. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: The slices, each { label, value } with value >= 0.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence stating the main takeaway.

props.name: categoryLabel
props.description: Heading for the slice names; "Category".

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Heading for the numbers; "Value".

props.name: unit
props.description: Text appended to numbers, such as "%" or " ms".

catalog.name: Meter
catalog.description: A value within a known range, such as disk usage or a score. Requires label and value; min is 0 and max is 100 unless given. Use ProgressBar for task progress.

props.name: label
props.description: What is measured. Required.

props.name: value
props.description: The current measurement, or an expression such as {"$expr": "used / total * 100"}.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest possible value; 0 by default.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest possible value; 100 by default.

props.name: low
props.description: Values below this are low.

props.name: high
props.description: Values above this are high.

props.name: optimum
props.description: The ideal value.

catalog.name: ProgressBar
catalog.description: Progress of a task from 0 to 100 percent. Requires label; omit value when the amount is unknown.

props.name: label
props.description: What is progressing. Required.

props.name: value
props.description: Percent complete, 0 to 100, or an expression; omit when unknown.

catalog.name: Output
catalog.description: A computed result shown next to the controls it depends on, such as a price or a total. Bind controls with {"$bind": name} and write the value as {"$expr": "..."} over those names, and it updates live. Requires label and value.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the result, such as 'Monthly total'. Required.

props.name: value
props.description: The result. Write {"$expr": "seats * 12"} so it recalculates as the person changes the controls bound to the names it reads.

props.name: unit
props.description: Text shown after a number, such as "%" or " per month".

catalog.name: Comparison
catalog.description: Sets options side by side, such as plans or products, with a recommended one. Requires caption, options, and features; each feature has one value per option, true or false for included or not.

props.name: caption
props.description: What is compared; it names the table. Required.

props.name: options
props.description: The things compared, such as plan names, left to right.

props.name: features
props.type: ({ name: string, values: (number | string | boolean | null)[] })[]
props.description: The rows, each { name, values }.

props.name: recommended
props.description: The name of the option to recommend, exactly as written in options.

catalog.name: CitedText
catalog.description: An answer whose claims point at numbered sources. Requires text with [1]-style markers and the list of sources ({ title, href?, note? }); the sources are listed under the text and each marker links to its source.

props.name: text
props.description: The answer as plain text. Mark each claim with the number of its source in square brackets, such as [1] or [2][3]. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

props.name: sources
props.type: { title: string, href?: URL, note?: string }[]
props.description: The sources, each { title, href?, note? }, numbered from 1.

catalog.name: Alert
catalog.description: A highlighted message: confirmation, information, a warning, or an error. Requires message; tone is info by default. Warnings and errors are announced immediately.

props.name: message
props.description: What the person needs to know, in a sentence or two.

props.name: tone
props.description: "info" by default.

props.name: title
props.description: Short bold lead-in.

catalog.name: Separator
catalog.description: A divider line between sections. Takes no required arguments.

props.name: orientation
props.description: "horizontal" by default.

catalog.name: Query
catalog.description: Calls one of the host's tools and stores the result under a name, again whenever a bound argument changes, without asking the assistant. Draws nothing: bind a chart's data, a table's rows, or a list's items to the name to show the result. Requires tool and into.

props.name: tool
props.description: Name of the host tool to call, from the list of tools.

props.name: args
props.description: Arguments for the tool; bind a value with {"$bind": name} and the query runs again whenever it changes.

props.name: into
props.description: Name to store the result under; show it with {"$bind": name} in a data prop such as a chart's data.

catalog.name: Slot
catalog.description: Places one of the host's own views, such as a live preview, by name. The host's views read values bound by your controls. Requires name.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of a host view to place here, from the list of host views.

expressionFunctions.name: round
expressionFunctions.summary: round(x, digits?) rounds to a number of decimals (0 to 10; 0 by default)

expressionFunctions.name: pow
expressionFunctions.summary: pow(x, y) is x to the power y

expressionFunctions.name: clamp
expressionFunctions.summary: clamp(x, low, high) keeps x between low and high

promptRules: Accessibility is required: every input has a visible label and a unique name; every chart and table has a title or caption; every image has alt text describing it; buttons and links say what they do; keep heading levels in order.
Never rely on color alone. State a trend, status, or warning in words as well (a chart description, a Text with a tone, an Alert).
Use Alert only for information the person must act on; use Text for ordinary explanations.
Plain text only: Markdown and HTML in text props are shown literally. Link only to http(s), mailto:, tel:, relative, or #fragment URLs.
Use components only when they help the person act or compare. A short answer needs just a Text inside a Stack.
Put controls in a Form with a clear submitLabel. Use RadioGroup for five or fewer options and Select for more, and give a sensible default value when you know one.

Pick the data component by purpose: Table for exact values, BarChart or ColumnChart to compare, LineChart or AreaChart for change over time, PieChart for parts of a whole (six slices at most), Meter for a value in a range, ProgressBar for a task.

Use Output for results that depend on the person's choices (a price, a total, a conversion). Bind the controls ({"$bind": "seats", "initial": 5}) and write the Output value as {"$expr": "seats * 12"}; it recalculates as they change the controls. Never compute such a value yourself.
Use Comparison for choosing between options (plans, products): one feature per row with a value per option, true or false for included or not, and recommended only when you can say why.
Use CitedText when claims come from sources: put [1]-style markers after each claim and list every source once, in order. Never invent a source or a URL.
End with Suggestions (two to four short follow-up replies) when the person would likely continue; use CopyButton only next to the visible text it copies.

Streaming: write type first, then every other prop, and children (or a list of items with children) last; a prop written after the children may be ignored. Put the content people read first at the top, so the interface appears top-down while you write.
